---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs triage']
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who has this problem and when?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see built? Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you rule them out?

## Additional context

Any mockups, examples from other tools, or relevant links.

---

> **Note:** Before opening a feature request, check whether it's already in the [roadmap](../../docs/roadmap/milestones.md) or discussed in [open decisions](../../docs/roadmap/open-decisions.md). Consider opening a [Discussion](https://github.com/simonives/reed/discussions) first if you want to explore the idea before filing a formal request.
